summary: H World Group Ltd, a Shanghai-domiciled hotel operator listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K covering the period ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit set is a routine interim financial reporting package, evidenced by XBRL-tagged balance sheet, equity, borrowings and share-based compensation data. No transaction, stake acquisition or disposal, board recommendation, advisor mandate or structural event is disclosed. The filing is not a special situation and carries no deal terms; no risk-arbitrage angle applies. Watch only for ordinary quarterly operating trends and any subsequent 6-K disclosing a corporate action.
